title: Deployment, recovery, and production readiness
subtitle: Turn local mechanisms into a measured deployment contract.
goal: Demonstrate that the system survives beyond one process
intro: Production readiness is evidence about failure and recovery under the actual deployment model.
case: Scale a single-process assistant to several replicas.
Task state, quotas, and operation identity remain coherent across instances.
Local dictionaries and semaphores do not become shared automatically.
